test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'JURY' is coded as 1397 and 'DOCK' is coded as 4632. How will 'FACTORIAL' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'JURY' is coded as 1397

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e026b084efbe31eb5a5147e8944f5d0f7ceec65f746f85f41299230507b18e58.png] 

And,

'DOCK' is coded as 4632

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a65622ef0fa07eebcd171cd6f5a7c9424435522f1abc355dbb186f1dca341bff.png] 

Similarly,

'FACTORIAL' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c924908dbf3462705b4d54a0414d55d6faccea056a7f00800e91a979db0020e9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"613269913"**
